scenes.heading: Snowflake Schema
scenes.narration: A snowflake schema is a star schema whose dimensions are normalized into related sub-tables.

scenes.heading: What normalizing dimensions gives you
bullets: Dimensions split into hierarchies of smaller tables.
Less duplicated data across dimension rows.
Cleaner updates when a shared attribute changes.
More joins are needed to answer a query.
scenes.narration: Instead of one wide dimension, a snowflake breaks it into linked tables that follow natural hierarchies like product to category to department. This removes duplication and makes shared attribute updates simple. The cost is extra joins, because a single dimension now spans several tables.

scenes.heading: Star vs snowflake
scenes.narration: A star schema keeps each dimension flat for speed, accepting some repeated values. A snowflake normalizes those dimensions to save space and ease updates, at the cost of more joins per query. The choice hinges on whether read speed or storage and consistency matters more for your workload.

scenes.heading: Navigating a snowflaked dimension
scenes.code:
SELECT c.category_name,
       SUM(f.sales_amount) AS revenue
FROM   fact_sales   f
JOIN   dim_product  p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN   dim_category c ON p.category_key = c.category_key
GROUP BY c.category_name;
scenes.narration: Because the product dimension is normalized, category lives in its own table. To roll sales up to category, the query hops from fact to product and then product to category. Each extra hop is a join, which is the defining trade-off of the snowflake design.

scenes.heading: When to reach for it
scenes.narration: Snowflaking earns its keep when dimensions are large and rich with hierarchies. It also helps when many rows share the same attribute values that you want to manage in one place. Under storage or governance pressure, splitting those hierarchies into sub-tables keeps the model tidy.

scenes.text: Snowflake schemas normalize dimensions into hierarchies, trading extra joins for less redundancy and easier updates.
scenes.narration: Reach for a snowflake when dimension consistency and storage outweigh the simplicity of a flat star.
